metadata.summary: With world championship leader Kimi Antonelli set to start from the back of the grid at the Italian Grand Prix, the trio of Brits attempting to chase him down at the top of the standings have a major opportunity.

Antonelli's Mercedes team-mate George Russell and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton both trail the Italian by 59 points, while reigning world champion Lando Norris has reduced his deficit to 83 points with victories at the last two races. Kimi Antonelli leads his Mercedes team-mate George Russell and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton by 59 points at the top of the standings, with McLaren's Lando Norris 83 points back in fourth after belatedly igniting his title defence with victories at the last two races. With 11 rounds remaining, Hamilton is 28 points clear of his Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc, while Norris has moved 55 points ahead of his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri. messages.text: Tiger Woods handed five-year driving ban after Florida crash

metadata.summary: Tiger Woods has been fined and suspended from driving for five years after entering a plea agreement to a reckless driving charge, following March’s rollover car crash in Florida.
metadata.content: Tiger Woods enters plea agreement to reckless driving charge and issued five-year driving suspension in Florida court | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content Tiger Woods enters plea agreement to reckless driving charge and issued five-year driving suspension in Florida court Tiger Woods has entered a plea agreement for reckless driving after the car crash outside his home in March; Woods' driving licence will be suspended for five years; Woods attended a plea conference hearing at Martin County Courthouse in Florida Wednesday 2 September 2026 15:04, UK Image: Tiger Woods has been issued a five-year driving ban Tiger Woods has been fined and suspended from driving for five years after entering a plea agreement to a reckless driving charge, following March’s rollover car crash in Florida. The 15-time major champion was arrested in March and spent eight hours in jail, before being bailed, after the Land Rover he was driving rolled over in a collision with a pick-up truck towing a trailer. Woods previously entered a written plea of not guilty via his lawyers to charges of driving under the influence, property damage and a refusal to submit to testing. metadata.summary: Everton's move for Monaco striker Folarin Balogun has fallen through following a change of heart from the player after the deal scuppered Chelsea's chances of signing Lamine Camara.
metadata.content: Folarin Balogun: Monaco striker's move to Everton falls through after deal scuppered Chelsea's chances of signing Lamine Camara | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Folarin Balogun: Monaco striker's move to Everton falls through after deal scuppered Chelsea's chances of signing Lamine Camara Folarin Balogun arrived on Merseyside at lunchtime on Deadline Day to complete the £40m move to Everton from Monaco; after midnight, it was confirmed that Balogun had a change of heart after the move also scuppered Chelsea's chances of signing Lamine Camara from Monaco Wednesday 2 September 2026 10:57, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports' Rob Dorsett explains why the collapse of the Folarin Balogun deal leaves Everton short of strikers for the season. Everton's move for Monaco striker Folarin Balogun has fallen through following a change of heart from the player after the deal scuppered Chelsea's chances of signing Lamine Camara. Balogun arrived in Merseyside at lunchtime to complete the £40m Deadline Day transfer, but doubts began to emerge that the deal would be completed after an issue came up in the medical.
